description:
A call center is onboarding two remote agents who need SIP phone entries configured in Vicidial before they can log into the dialer. Create two phone extensions in the Vicidial admin panel.

First, determine the Vicidial Asterisk server IP by navigating to Admin > Servers in the Vicidial admin panel. Note the server IP shown for the active server.

Then navigate to the Phones section and create the following two phone entries:

**Phone Extension 1:**
- Extension: 8501
- Dialplan Number: 8501
- Voicemail ID: 8501
- Phone Login: cc_remote_8501
- Phone Password: Xk9mPw2nQ
- Registration Password: Xk9mPw2nQ
- Server IP: (the server IP you found in the Servers section)
- Protocol: SIP
- Local GMT: -5.00 (US Eastern)
- Phone Type: Remote SIP Softphone
- Full Name: Remote Agent East
- Active: Y

**Phone Extension 2:**
- Extension: 8502
- Dialplan Number: 8502
- Voicemail ID: 8502
- Phone Login: cc_remote_8502
- Phone Password: Qr7nLv4bZ
- Registration Password: Qr7nLv4bZ
- Server IP: (the same server IP)
- Protocol: SIP
- Local GMT: -6.00 (US Central)
- Phone Type: Remote SIP Softphone
- Full Name: Remote Agent Central
- Active: Y

Both phones must be saved and appear in the Phones listing.

Vicidial admin credentials: user 6666, password andromeda
Admin URL: http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php
